title: Finite locally free internal-module derived Hom formula
statement: Let X be a scheme with noetherian underlying space, Λ a commutative condensed ring object in universe u, and P an internal Λ_X-module. Suppose a pro-etale covering of X makes P finite free after ordinary pullback. There exists an additive endofunctor H of internal Λ_X-modules preserving finite limits, finite colimits and all (u+1)-small colimits such that, for every integer n, the functor K ↦ Hom(P[0],QK[n]) to abelian groups is naturally isomorphic to degree-n cohomology of RΓ(H(K)). Here H acts termwise on arbitrary cochain complexes, Γ is the specified internal-module global sections functor, and Q is localization to the ordinary derived category. The statement has no filtered diagram or colimit comparison.

theorem condensed_finite_free_derived_hom
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace X]
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (hP : ∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ s : C.I₀,
      Mod.IsFree ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).obj (condensedRingObj Λ X))
        (((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).mapMod (condensedRingObj Λ X)).obj P))
    : ∃ H :
        Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X) ⥤
          Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X),
      Exists fun [_hadd : H.Additive] ↦
        PreservesFiniteLimits H ∧ PreservesFiniteColimits H ∧
        PreservesColimitsOfSize.{u + 1, u + 1} H ∧
        ∀ n : ℤ, Nonempty
          (condensedShiftedHom Λ X ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj P) n ≅
            H.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q ⋙
              (condensedModuleSections Λ X).rightDerivedFunctor ⋙
                DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n)
